title: OutLayer 솔로 #158 · Polynesian goddess · 레드 새틴 스트링 트라이앵글 · 시어 심 스타킹+맨다리페인팅 · 머리 넘기기 · 인도 궁전 안뜰
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 50s goddess, Polynesian goddess physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person; a powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere; thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing; her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame; solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long curly chestnut brown hair — wearing a glossy red satin string micro bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups tied with thin glossy red satin strings at her neck and back, and a minimal low-rise glossy red satin bottom of one tiny opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque pieces fully covering her, her stomach bare. Her right leg wears a sheer black thigh-high stocking with a wide lace top band and a dark seam running up the back, hugging her right thigh, knee, calf and ankle and running down into her heel, her warm bronze-brown skin faintly visible through the sheer nylon, matching the rest of her body. Her left leg is bare from the hip to the toes. Pose: one hand sweeping her hair back, the other resting on her hip, one leg crossed in front to show the boot — most extreme Polynesian goddess silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy red satin, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, in glossy red lacquer with a high polish.
Body paint: a black floral lace stocking pattern with a scalloped top edge at the upper thigh, painted directly on the skin from the thigh down to the ankle, covering her entire left leg only, a fine opaque painted pattern on the bare skin of that leg.
Piercing: a large curved gold navel barbell with a big round red ruby at the bottom and a smaller clear gem above, resting directly on her skin at her navel.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and large drop earrings of mixed metals, a gold chain ending in a heavy silver weight on each ear, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline.

Background: a sunlit Indian palace courtyard of pale sandstone with carved arches of standard height, low steps and a waist-high jali screen, in clear sunny daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
